title: 第1616章 海战运输平台圆一百第1615章 镇海联盟
content_zh:
此时南方诸岛最强者之一的拜伦·廉德，就像是一个战利品一般，被摆在一旁警示着众人。
杀鸡儆猴的他们见多了，现在遇见一个杀狗儆猴的，这由不得他们不重视，所以立即收回目光，专心致志的听他讲话。
“既然我决定将抵抗联盟改名成镇海联盟，那么我认为我们应该改变应对方案，不再是被动抵抗，而应该狠狠镇压这些海族。”
“可主动出击的话，我们的战船不够，无法运输全部人手，而且远离海岛与海族在大海作战，这对于我们来说太劣势了。”
海族发动大浪潮上岸，都能将人族大陆上的国家打得节节败退，在大海这个主场中作战，那更是棘手，毕竟他们不可能像虚空群岛一般全浮空战船作战。
“战船这事简单，我研制了一种适合海战的运输平台，订购权限只开放给镇海联盟成员，你们感兴趣的话可以了解一下。”
说着默里·格林打了个响指，几个巨大的空间洞从其身下打开，里面落下许多零配件，它们掉落在海中后自行武装起来。
没多久，一个直径百米的黑色圆盘漂浮在海面上，在默里·格林的带领下，众人落在了这个圆盘运输平台上。
“它是我根据南方诸岛的地形，专门研制出来的海战运输平台·圆一百，它上面经过特殊处理，就算是有水的情况下，人站在上面也不会打滑，方便战斗。”
“而且它上面还有五十个出入口，能够让平台内的战斗人员快速进出，完成备战。”
说着默里·格林意念一动，海战运输平台上面的进出口全部打开，好奇的众人马上跟着默里·格林走进其中。
海战运输平台·圆一百的内部结构比较简单，是由多个圆环重叠而成，然后由四根直径通道将其贯通，除了正中央是驾驶室外，其他地方都可以让人自由活动。
而其最外层的圆环的外壁是由特制魔法玻璃钢打造而成，不仅坚固得能够抵御海兽撞击，还是单向透明的，可以让内部的人员观察外面情况。
海战运输平台·圆一百底部也有出入口，可以直接从底部进入大海，与海族战斗。
“平台表面拥有防御法阵，还拥有潜水功能，所以不管从上面，还是从下面进出，都不需要担心进水问题。”
“如果防御法阵被打破，平台外层装甲也被攻破，进水的通道可以单独封闭，不会影响到其他通道的使用。”
默里·格林启动海战运输平台，潜入海中，带着众人参观了一下这个新玩意，见识过这海战运输平台后，众人顿时对其惊为天物。
与海战运输平台相比，以往的魔法战船简直是弱爆了。
它的圆形结构，使得它漂浮在海上时，就像是一块平坦的小岛，方便战士列阵战斗，也方便魔法师施法作战。
并且它能做到三百六十度无死角对抗，不给海族在死角凿船的机会。

海战运输平台本身是全封闭结构，因此可以潜水，在水中移动，不必担心海上风浪，雷暴，暴雨等情况。
而战船只能漂浮在海面上，要是遭遇恶劣天气和海况，很容易翻船。
但海战运输平台就算被很大的巨浪将其掀翻也无所谓，直接在海中翻个身就行了，直接不存在翻船事故了。
见识完这个海战运输平台·圆一百后，众人看向默里·格林的眼神，从原本的谨慎和戒备，终于多了几分崇敬。
暗道默里·格林这个新官来了也不是光放火，终于做出了对大家都有利的事情了。
天下熙熙，皆为利来。
所以从默里·格林身上看到好处的众人，心中对其强行成为联盟盟主的怨气消散了许多，有些人还认为，他要是不成为盟主，哪里会为联盟提供如此海战神器。
于是不少人放下矜持，开始围在身边询问有关于海战运输平台更多的事情，然后咨询订购价格，盟友能不能打折。
对此默里·格林，给第一个下单的人打了九折，作为福利，还直接用在场的这个海战运输平台·圆一百进行现货交付。
然后给第二人打了九一折，不过他得去科技岛提货，科技岛提前制作了一些库存，也是现货，第三人为九二折。
其他人看见先下单有折扣，而且越晚折扣越少，晚了还可能没有库存现货，还得等新制造后，他们马上争抢着下单。
甚至有几个本来就存在恩怨的势力主，因为谁先下单的事起了口角，差点打起来，对此，那些还对默里·格林比较戒备的势力主们，直接傻眼了。
他们朝着这些“叛徒”投去了恨铁不成钢的眼神，好歹是堂堂一个势力的主人，为了这点便宜差点打起来，就不嫌丢脸吗？
转眼间，前十个下单的人名单确定下来，后面所有人都只能按照原价下单。
可这依旧没有打消剩下人的热情，因为库存有限，早点可以拿现货，迅速投入战斗，提升实力。
晚了的话，还得等制造，说不定还得等到什么时候去了，万一那时候双方开战，有没有这海战运输平台很影响战斗力。
而默里·格林则通过这海战运输平台·圆一百，直接打破了联盟中人的默契，拉拢了一些愿意向他靠近的势力，在联盟中不再是光杆司令。
虽然他可以用实力强行对这些盟友下达命令，但强行执行任务，和心甘情愿的出手，能起到的效果完全是天差地别的，所以他愿意通过让利来获得一批人手。
手中有了人后，默里·格林才在联盟中站稳脚跟，接下来事情就很简单了，拉拢一批，打击一批。
顺便把不愿意听从他指挥和命令的人，当做炮灰消耗一批，整个镇海联盟就能被他完全掌控了。

向这些人介绍完这海战运输平台·圆一百，并收到不少订单与订金后，默里·格林又将众人围过来，开了个短会。
“现在我们镇海联盟的势力没有海族强，就算有海战运输平台相助，短时间内没法占据优势，所有我们还得扩张势力。”
默里·格林开口定下了这场短会的基调。

content_en:
At this time, Byron Lian De, one of the strongest men in the southern islands, was placed aside like a trophy to warn everyone.
They had seen many people who killed chickens to scare monkeys, and now they met someone who killed dogs to scare monkeys. They couldn't help but take it seriously, so they immediately withdrew their eyes and listened to him attentively.
"Since I decided to change the name of the Resistance Alliance to the Zhenhai Alliance, I think we should change our response plan. Instead of passive resistance, we should severely suppress these Hai clan."
"But if we take the initiative, we don't have enough warships to transport all the people, and we are far away from the island and fighting with the sea tribe in the sea. This is too disadvantageous for us."
The Sea Clan can launch a large wave ashore and defeat the countries on the human continent. It is even more difficult to fight in the sea, their home field. After all, they cannot fight with all floating warships like the Void Islands.
"The matter of warships is simple. I have developed a transportation platform suitable for naval battles. The ordering authority is only open to Zhenhai Alliance members. If you are interested, you can learn about it."
As he spoke, Murray Green snapped his fingers, and several huge space holes opened from under him, and many spare parts fell inside. They armed themselves after falling into the sea.
Not long after, a black disk with a diameter of 100 meters floated on the sea. Under the leadership of Murray Green, everyone landed on the disk transportation platform.
"It is a naval combat transport platform, Yuan Hundred, specially developed by me based on the terrain of the southern islands. It has been specially treated so that even if there is water, people standing on it will not slip, making it easier to fight."
"And there are fifty entrances and exits on it, which can allow combatants on the platform to quickly enter and exit to complete preparations for war."
As Murray Green spoke, all the entrances and exits on the naval transport platform were opened, and the curious people immediately followed Murray Green into it.
The internal structure of the naval combat transport platform Circle One Hundred is relatively simple. It is made up of multiple overlapping rings and is connected by four diameter channels. Except for the cab in the center, people can move freely in other places.
The outer wall of the outermost ring is made of special magic fiberglass. It is not only strong enough to withstand the impact of sea monsters, but is also one-way transparent, allowing people inside to observe the outside situation.
There is also an entrance and exit at the bottom of the naval battle transport platform "Yuanbai". You can enter the sea directly from the bottom to fight the sea clan.
"The platform has a defensive array on the surface and also has a diving function, so whether you enter or exit from above or below, you don't need to worry about water intrusion."
"If the defensive array is broken and the outer armor of the platform is also broken, the water inlet channel can be sealed separately without affecting the use of other channels."
Murray Green activated the naval combat transport platform, dived into the sea, and took everyone to see this new gadget. After seeing the naval combat transport platform, everyone was immediately amazed by it.
Compared with naval combat transport platforms, the previous magic warships were simply weak.
Its circular structure makes it look like a flat island when floating on the sea, which is convenient for warriors to form battle arrays and for magicians to cast spells.
Moreover, it can achieve 360-degree confrontation with no blind spots, giving the Sea Clan no chance to sink the ship in the blind spots.
The naval combat transport platform itself is a fully enclosed structure, so it can dive and move in the water without worrying about sea waves, thunderstorms, heavy rains, etc.
Warships can float on the sea, but they can easily capsize if they encounter bad weather and sea conditions.
But even if the naval transport platform is overturned by huge waves, it doesn't matter. It can just turn over in the sea, and there will be no capsizing accident.
After seeing this naval battle transport platform, Yuan Hundred, everyone looked at Murray Green. Their original cautiousness and alertness finally gave way to a little more reverence.
SecretlyWhen the new official Li Green came, he didn't just set fire to it. He finally did something that was beneficial to everyone.
The world is prosperous, and everyone is here for profit.
Therefore, everyone who saw the benefits from Murray Green dissipated a lot of their resentment towards him forcibly becoming the leader of the alliance. Some people also believed that if he had not become the leader, how would he have provided such a naval warfare artifact to the alliance.
So many people put down their reserve and began to gather around to ask more about the naval combat transport platform, and then inquired about the order price and whether allies could get discounts.
In response to this, Murray Green gave a 10% discount to the first person to place an order. As a bonus, he also directly used the naval combat transportation platform Yuanbai to deliver the goods directly.
Then I gave the second person a 91% discount, but he had to go to Science and Technology Island to pick up the goods. Science and Technology Island made some inventory in advance, which was also in stock, and the third person got a 92% discount.
Others saw that there was a discount for placing an order first, and that the later the product was placed, the smaller the discount was. If it was later, the product might not be in stock and had to wait until it was newly manufactured, they immediately rushed to place an order.
There were even some faction leaders who had grievances with them. They almost got into a fight because of a quarrel over who placed the order first. In response, those faction leaders who were still wary of Murray Green were dumbfounded.
They looked at these "traitors" with hateful eyes. After all, they are the masters of the same power, and they almost got into a fight for this advantage. Isn't it embarrassing?
In the blink of an eye, the list of the first ten people who placed orders was determined, and everyone after that could only place orders at the original price.
But this still did not dampen the enthusiasm of the remaining people, because the inventory is limited, they can get the spot early and quickly enter the battle to improve their strength.
If it's late, we still have to wait for manufacturing, and maybe we'll have to wait until later. If the two sides start a war at that time, the presence of this naval combat transport platform will greatly affect the combat effectiveness.
Murray Green, on the other hand, directly broke the tacit understanding among the people in the alliance through this naval transportation platform, Yuan Hundred, and attracted some forces that were willing to get closer to him. He was no longer the mere commander in the alliance.
Although he can use his strength to forcefully issue orders to these allies, the effect of forcibly executing tasks and taking action willingly are completely different, so he is willing to obtain a group of manpower by giving away profits.
After having people in his hands, Murray Green gained a firm foothold in the league. The next thing is very simple, recruit a group of people and attack a group of people.
By the way, by using a group of people who are unwilling to obey his commands and orders as cannon fodder, he can completely control the entire Zhenhai Alliance.
After introducing the naval transportation platform Yuan Hundred to these people and receiving many orders and deposits, Murray Green gathered everyone around and held a short meeting.
"Right now, our Zhenhai Alliance is not as powerful as the Hai Clan. Even with the help of the naval transportation platform, we won't be able to take advantage in a short time, so we still have to expand our power."
Murray Green set the tone for the short meeting.
